title: Conformal Robust Set Estimation
summary: We introduce a robust conformal prediction method based on the half-mass radius $\dP(x):=\inf\{r>0:P(B(x,r))>1/2\}$. Its empirical version is exactly the distance from a point to its $\mathbf{k}$-th nearest neighbour, with $\mathbf{k}=\lfloor n/2\rfloor+1$. The resulting conformal sets retain finite-sample marginal validity and asymptotically target the robust population central set $\Qba:=\{x\in\R^d:\dP(x)\leβ_α\}$.
